Title: Abandoned Cyber City
Description:
[b]Abandoned Cyber City[/b] — a systems-depth custom Zombies map for Black Ops III.

[b]Systems[/b]
[list]
[*]Data Shards — a risk/reward currency you gamble at the Glitch Altar
[*]Cyberware — permanent per-run upgrades
[*]Overclocks — per-gun stat tiers (speed / precision / impact / efficiency)
[*]Elite enemies + a mini-boss, with per-round boss encounters
[*]Seven interconnected zones, buyable doors, a trench, and an underground vault
[*]Per-run randomization for replayability
[/list]

[b]Credits[/b]
Map & systems by the Abandoned Cyber City project.
Custom LUI HUD compiled with L3akMod (D3V Team).
Third-party assets credited per their authors — see the full credits in the Workshop description before public release.

[b]Feedback[/b]
Report bugs and balance notes in the comments.
